current_release_migrations.note: Durable Tool condition/service/repair/calibration/retirement/replacement authority only. It never consumes Tool quantity or writes stock movements.

deferred_it_test_environment.feature_development_assumption: Continue implementing against Development test/provider abstractions as though required key references are populated. Real credential/provider/media acceptance is completed later from the I.T. test environment.

workstreams.scope: Keep Web, Phone and Desktop active first-class clients of one responsive/installable application with explicit opt-in notifications and no idle polling.
Shop remains direct Product discovery; Collections add rule-based/curated metadata and Product membership; Collages are reusable visual arrangements of approved public Product images.
New in-house Products require real material lineage before publication when schema is active; legacy Products remain nonblocking and outside finished goods may be exempt.
Durable Tool/mold provenance remains separate from consumable Inventory.
Normalized manufacturer/vendor provenance and Devil n Dove-authored purchased-item reviews with safe source references.
Transparent photography scoring, catalog work queue, duplicate flags, hero/gallery recommendations and human review.

Read-only prioritized work queue over site_item_inventory and existing Product/resource authorities for stockouts, low stock, reorder, blocked reuse, identity, sourcing, manufacturer, usage-profile and Product-impact issues. No duplicate stock authority.
Durable Tool lifecycle profiles and events for condition, service, repairs, calibration, safety, retirement and replacement planning without Tool quantity consumption.
Packages only approved source-backed temporal/story evidence into reference-only Content Studio handoffs. Historical Build identities remain provenance only.
I.T.-owned provider/platform reference metadata with configured/tested states; secret values forbidden.
Home and Movie cover presentation reuse one accessible Release 448 carousel authority with truthful fallback and no extra H1.
Enriched JSON plus movie_catalog D1 overlay with explicit metadata review states; never guess unknown data.
Pending, legacy_pending, exempt, unverified, verified and evidence states remain explicit.
